draft_key_information_units.information: Group revenue increased to EUR 76.7 million (2025) from EUR 68.0 million (2024), while Group net profit rose to EUR 13.2 million from EUR 11.9 million. Company revenue grew to EUR 72.8 million from EUR 65.0 million, with net profit of EUR 11.6 million compared to EUR 10.7 million.

Operating profit increased to EUR 21.3 million (2025) from EUR 18.9 million (2024), driven by higher LNG regasification volumes, full terminal operational capacity (vs. 1.5 months downtime in 2024), and client capacity bonuses; offset partially by reduced LNG security supplement income due to regulatory excess return repayments.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income and Note 13 (page 13)

draft_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Liquid Energy Terminals (LET) revenue was EUR 21.9 million (2025 vs EUR 21.1 million), LNG Terminal (LNGT) revenue rose to EUR 45.6 million (vs EUR 38.4 million), and commercial LNG activities revenue increased to EUR 9.2 million (vs EUR 8.5 million).
Net cash generated from operating activities surged to EUR 76.3 million in 2025 from EUR 35.6 million in 2024, primarily due to higher net profit and working capital improvements.

Group borrowings decreased slightly to EUR 294.4 million (2025) from EUR 301.4 million (2024), while lease liabilities remained stable at approximately EUR 24 million. Cash and cash equivalents increased significantly to EUR 54.4 million from EUR 17.2 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 9 (page 11) and Statement of Cash Flow (page 6)

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic developments include the acquisition of a Floating Storage and Regasification Unit (FSRU) in December 2024 and the establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH to operate the Wilhelmshaven 2 floating LNG import terminal.
